Question: What is the support value of the node "ana=NAM"?
Evidence:
[E1] (text, Section A, page 13): X 1 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=F } , C ( X 1 ) = 0 X 2 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=T } , C ( X 2 ) = 1 X 3 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NOM, headmatch=F } , C ( X 3 ) = 0 • A = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=F, head-match=T, ant-type=NOM } , • support ( a i , 0) a i ∈ A = { 2,1,2,0,1 } , e.g. “anatype=NAM” appeared two times in noncoreferring ( C ( X i ) = 0 ) samples, If we sort A based on a i ’s frequencies, i.e. support ( a i , 0) + support ( a i , 1) , the ordering of A ’s items will remain the same. Now, we need to go through the samples again to build the tree. The FP-Tree construction steps after adding each of the above samples is demonstrated in Figure 1 . ana-type=NAM, anttype=NAM, head-match=F, head-match=T, and ant-type=NOM are abbreviated as ana=NAM, ant=NAM, head=F, head=T, and ant=NOM, respectively in Figures 1 and 2 . Figure 2 shows the resulted FP-Tree in which corresponding support values for both classes, i.e. zero and one, are also included in each node.
[E2] (text, Section 6.2, page 5): X 1 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=F } , C ( X 1 ) = 0 X 2 = { ana-type=NAM, ant-type=NAM, headmatch=T } , C ( X 2 ) = 1
[E3] (text, Section 6.2, page 5): The FP-Tree construction steps for the above samples are demonstrated in Figure 1 . ana-type, ant-type, and head-match features are abbreviated as ana, ant, and head, respectively.
[E4] (table, Table 2, page 4): Table 2 : Out-of-domain evaluation of deep-coref models on the WikiCoref dataset.
Values (cite as cells):
  row 'ranking': 'MUC' = 63.10; 'B3' = 48.43; 'CEAFe' = 47.18; 'CoNLL' = 52.90; 'LEA' = 44.40
  row 'top-pairs': 'MUC' = 63.09; 'B3' = 48.42; 'CEAFe' = 46.05; 'CoNLL' = 52.52; 'LEA' = 44.21
  row '+linguistic': 'MUC' = 63.99; 'B3' = 49.63; 'CEAFe' = 46.60; 'CoNLL' = 53.40; 'LEA' = 45.66
[E5] (figure, Figure 2, page 14) (image attached): Figure 2 : FP-Tree with corresponding support values of the nodes.
Words printed in the figure: ROOT ana=NAM (2,1) ant=NAM (1,1) head=F (1,0) head=T (0,1) head=F (1,0) ant=NOM (1,0)
[E6] (figure, Figure 2, page 14): a zoomed view of Figure 2 (image attached)

These claims are already verified and kept:
- The support value of the node 'ana=NAM' is 2.

These claims failed the checks; write corrected claims to replace them:
- "The node 'ana=NAM' has a support value of 2 for the class 0.": the number 0 is in no citation
- "The node 'ana=NAM' has a support value of 1 for the class 1.": the number 1, 1 is in no citation
- "The evidence does not provide the support value of the node 'ana=NAM' for the class 0.": support check: The cited evidence in E1 (Section A) provides the support values for the class 0, but it does not specify the support value of the node 'ana=NAM' for the class 0. The claim is not supported by the evidence. [image]
